## Changes

- Fix iOS release startup failing with “Could not load devices”. The native
  terminal engine's C interfaces are now retained in the executable's dynamic
  exports so Dart FFI can resolve them in release builds.
- Check all 32 Dart FFI entry points in iOS release builds in CI, preventing a
  successful compile from hiding missing runtime exports.
- Preserve request correlation when forwarding application commands.
- Bundle the Windows ConPTY runtime for lossless terminal history.
- Keep the connection mascot in place and collapse route error details.
- Update dependencies and refresh the embedded web client.

## Downloads

CLI archives cover macOS, Linux, and Windows on amd64 and arm64. Android
downloads include signed per-ABI APKs, a universal APK, and a Play AAB.
SHA256 checksums and build metadata are included. This remains a beta release.

Android version: `0.0.1-beta.14`; base version code: `20`.
iOS version: `0.0.1`; build: `20`, distributed separately through
[TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/rfcgFyJh).
